contracts.projects: Native project metadata is separate from registered workspace roots. CRUD/order use nativeProjectId/beforeNativeProjectId. Creation/import and explicit root replacement send only registered projectIds, never paths/cwd. Name-only edits omit roots/metadata to preserve unknown or unregistered metadata. Import supports current full-history-loaded thread only, requires global idle, and uses a stable per-form idempotencyKey.
contracts.sections: Native section create/update/delete with persisted name/appearance; explicit deletion states association-only semantics. Current-thread move carries sectionId and beforeThreadId chosen from same registered cwd and selected section. Sidebar shows native section labels and supports recency or native section-position ordering.
contracts.thread: Pure thread/read supplies native project/section and readState revision. Mark read/unread sends captured expectedRevision; stale updates never retry. Stop-subscribe does not claim process unload; permanent history deletion requires complete readiness,idle and explicit user confirmation. Memory-mode buttons report only this accepted action and do not invent a readback state.
contracts.attachments: Purpose-built HTTP(S),pull-request and registered-project-relative file-description forms save native association metadata. No upload, checkout or external action. Removal confirms metadata-only intent. Owner search stays registered-project scoped and empty filtered pages retain pagination.
contracts.delivery: Durable mutation/unknown-receipt workflow for all changes. Original IDs are queried; no automatic replay. Late accepted deletion returns to list. Unsent project/section selection survives unrelated metadata refresh; inputs are disabled during submitted form work to avoid discarding newer typing. Pending global operations block another organization write.
contracts.backendSemantics: Runtime owner separately confirmed with official CLI that native project/section deletion removes organization/associations only and preserves thread history and workspace files. This UI report does not independently re-run that native probe.

Association forms cover links,PR links and file descriptions; no generic arbitrary payload RPC editor is exposed.
No fake current memoryMode state; native API has no readback field.
